referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module includes the most important materials used for production, the energy needed for production, planning and engineering. Also included is the transport of the raw materials, the engine delivery and the installation on site.
referenceFunction.name: SOFC fuel cell 125kWe, future

technology.text: Solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) with unpressurised tubular stack design for central cogeneration use. Performance, stack lifetime and catalyst use according to expected future values for a serial product. Operation with connection to low pressure gas network. Electrical efficiency 47%, total efficiency 80%.
